prompt: STYLE: premium LOW-POLY diorama game art, like a polished stylised low-poly sports game. The two attached images are style references for the look only (flat-shaded faceted polygons, boxy characters with round disc heads): copy that look, NOT their composition. Everything is built from visible flat-shaded polygons and blocks, hard facets, no smooth gradients on surfaces. Characters are chunky BLOCK people: box torso, box arms and legs, blocky hands and feet, a round flat disc head with a simple flat illustrated face (two dot eyes, small smile), no realistic anatomy, no skin pores, no cloth folds. The stadium, stands and crowd are faceted low-poly too: crowd made of tiny blocky figures. Pitch is bright green with mowing stripes, flat colour. Premium lighting: floodlight beams and light haze, soft ambient occlusion, a slight bevel on the blocks, teal-and-gold night colour grade, crisp clean render, NOT a photograph, NOT realistic, NOT smooth CGI. Vertical 9:16 frame. Anonymous characters: one team in plain red-and-white kits, the other in plain blue kits. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO crests, NO badges, NO signage, NO advertising boards anywhere. Keep the top fifth of the frame clean and uncluttered for overlays. Scene: a wide high view across the whole packed faceted stadium bowl at night, one hundred thousand tiny blocky fans, left sectors red and white, right sectors blue, long red and blue scarves raised overhead as thin flat ribbons, red flares with smoke in the fan sectors, floodlight beams and haze, the green striped pitch far below at the bottom with tiny block players.
